description: FP_FG_222 is the drawing identifier for distribution enclosure flange in Hensel's ENYSTAR enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. A distribution flange forms a selected boundary or connection interface in a modular enclosure system. It must be coordinated with the adjoining enclosures or cable-entry arrangement.

For example, in a modular distribution assembly joining selected enclosure sections, use the FP_FG_222 reference to coordinate flange mating surfaces, fixing and cable passage where specified. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as ENYSTAR_Flansche/FP_FG_222.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep flange mating surfaces, fixing and cable passage where specified visible in the layout.
